hints.title: Week by Week City Transitions
hints.text: Track the maximum vacation days achievable in each city at the end of each week, starting from city zero.

hints.title: Reachability and Flight Connectivity
hints.text: A city can transition to itself or to any other connected city via available flights on Monday morning.

hints.title: Dynamic Programming over Weeks
hints.text: Maintain an array dp of size n representing maximum days ending in each city for the current week, initialized with city 0 at 0 and others unreachable. For each week, update all reachable destinations from each valid source city adding that destination week vacation days.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal dynamic programming maintaining current week city scores.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive branching across N cities over K weeks takes O(N^K) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Rolling 1D array over cities avoids allocating full N x K table.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: A city can always stay in place (flights[i][i] is implicitly valid), and only valid flights connect cities on Mondays.
